Command Reference

Overview of available commands and interface elements in IFU Analyzer.

Toolbar Buttons

The main toolbar at the top of the window provides quick access to core functions:

Open FITS

Click to browse and load a FITS data cube file. Supports MUSE, ALMA, MIRI, and NIRSpec data.

Select Region

Activate region selection tools to define areas for analysis.

Fit Single Pixel

Perform Gaussian fitting on the current spectrum (interactive).

Fit Full Cube

Run Gaussian fitting across all pixels in the cube (batch processing).

Subtract Continuum

Remove baseline emission from the spectrum.

CO Flux Extraction

Extract CO line flux measurements (specialized for CO observations).

Change Colormap

Select different color schemes for the intensity map display.

Adjust Color Scale

Set color scaling: linear, logarithmic, power law, or square root.

Zoom In/Out

Magnify or reduce the intensity map view.

Reset View

Return to default zoom and view settings.

Display Controls

Wavelength Slider (Left panel)

Navigate through the data cube:

  • Click and drag to move through wavelengths smoothly

  • Click specific wavelength labels to jump to that channel

  • View shows currently selected wavelength

Intensity Range (vmin/vmax) (Left panel)

Adjust brightness and contrast:

  • Move sliders to set minimum and maximum display values

  • Auto-scale button sets optimal range automatically

Colormap Selection (Left panel)

Choose color scheme:

  • Select from available colormaps

  • Preview shows color gradient

Right-Click Options

On Intensity Map

  • View pixel statistics

  • Clear current selection

  • Other region-based operations

On Spectrum

  • Export spectrum

  • View fitting results

  • Zoom into spectral region

Dialog Windows

File Operations

Dialogs appear for:

  • Loading FITS files

  • Exporting data (spectrum, results, residuals)

  • Choosing output formats and locations

Analysis Options

Dialogs available for:

  • Gaussian fitting parameters

  • Continuum subtraction settings

  • CO flux extraction options

Display Settings

Configure through dialogs:

  • Color scale properties

  • Intensity range adjustments

  • Colormap selection

Finding Commands

To locate a command:

  1. Toolbar: Look for matching button with icon and tooltip

  2. Right-click: Try right-clicking on data area for context options

  3. Dialog Buttons: Look within dialog windows that appear after you select a tool

  4. Status Bar: Check bottom of window for confirmation and current state

Tips

  • Hover over toolbar buttons to see tooltips describing their function

  • Most data operations require loading a FITS file first

  • Right-click is your best friend for discovering available options on data

  • Dialog windows appear for detailed settings when you click major operations

  • Scroll wheel

  • Menu buttons

  • Keyboard shortcut

Fit to Window (Ctrl+0)

Automatically scale view to fill window.

Reset View

Return to default zoom and pan.

Coordinate System

Select coordinate system for display.

Options:

  • Wavelength (default)

  • RA/DEC (if WCS available)

Color Scale

Change intensity scaling method.

Options:

  • Linear

  • Logarithmic

  • Power Law

  • Square Root

Show Grid

Toggle coordinate grid overlay.

Options:

  • Grid color

  • Grid spacing

  • Grid labels

Show Colorbar

Toggle intensity scale display.

Show Measurements

Show/hide measurement overlays.

Tools Menu

Region Selection

Tools for selecting spatial regions.

Sub-menu:

  • Point Tool: Single pixels

  • Rectangle Tool: Rectangular regions

  • Circle Tool: Circular regions

  • Ellipse Tool: Elliptical regions

  • Polygon Tool: Custom shapes

Options:

  • Feather edges

  • Invert selection

  • Border selection

  • Union/intersection modes

Spectral Analysis

Analyze spectral properties.

Sub-menu:

  • Feature Detection: Find emission/absorption lines

  • Line Identification: Identify known lines

  • Measure Equivalent Width

  • Export Spectra

Gaussian Fitting

Fit Gaussian models to spectra.

Sub-menu:

  • Fit Single: Interactive fitting

  • Fit Cube: Batch processing

  • View Results: Display parameter maps

  • Fit Options: Configure parameters

Continuum Subtraction

Remove baseline from spectra.

Sub-menu:

  • Simple Subtract: Built-in models

  • Advanced Subtraction: Custom parameters

  • Apply to All Pixels

  • Automatic Detection

CO Flux Extraction

Extract carbon monoxide line fluxes.

Sub-menu:

  • Simple Measurement: Single line

  • Multi-Line Analysis: Multiple CO transitions

  • Full Cube: Extract CO at every pixel

  • Temperature Calculation

Right-Click Context Menus

On Intensity Map

  • Copy Screen: Copy map to clipboard

  • Save Image: Export map as image

  • Rotate: Rotate displayed image

  • Mirror: Mirror image

  • Statistics: Show region statistics

  • Clear Selection: Deselect current region

  • Add Measurement: Annotate measurement

  • Properties: Edit map properties

On Spectrum

  • Export Spectrum: Save spectrum (Ctrl+E)

  • Copy: Copy spectrum to clipboard

  • Fit: Fit Gaussian to spectrum

  • Zoom: Zoom to spectral region

  • Statistics: Show statistics

  • Clear: Reset spectrum display

  • Options: Configure spectrum display

  • Properties: Edit spectrum properties

On Empty Area (Canvas)

  • Reset View: Return to default view

  • Properties: Edit display properties

  • Load Region: Load saved region

  • Save Region: Save current region

  • Clear All: Deselect and reset

Dialog Commands

Open FITS Dialog

Buttons:

  • Browse: Select file

  • OK: Open selected file

  • Cancel: Abort

  • Advanced: More options

Export Spectrum Dialog

Options:

  • Format: ASCII, FITS, CSV

  • Normalized: Yes/No

  • Include Errors: Yes/No

  • Columns: Select specific columns

  • Delimiter: Tab, comma, space

Buttons:

  • Browse: Choose location

  • Export: Save file

  • Cancel: Abort

Gaussian Fitting Dialog

Configuration:

  • Method: Interactive or automatic

  • Wavelength range: Select lines to fit

  • Initial guess: Provide starting values

  • Constraints: Set parameter limits

  • Continuum: Subtract baseline first

  • Weighting: Use error bars

Buttons:

  • Start: Begin fitting

  • Options: Advanced settings

  • Cancel: Abort

Region Selection Dialog

Tool Selection:

  • Point, Rectangle, Circle, Ellipse, Polygon

Options:

  • Mode: Replace, Add, Subtract, Intersect

  • Feather: Soften edges

  • Invert: Select everything except region

  • Border: Select only edges

Buttons:

  • OK: Apply selection

  • Clear: Deselect

  • Load: Load saved region

  • Save: Save current region

  • Cancel: Cancel operation

Continuum Subtraction Dialog

Model Selection:

  • Linear

  • Quadratic

  • Cubic

  • Spline

  • Blackbody

  • Power-Law

Parameters:

  • Wavelength ranges for fitting

  • Model order (if applicable)

  • Fitting method

Buttons:

  • Preview: Show result before applying

  • Apply: Perform subtraction

  • Cancel: Abort

CO Flux Dialog

Options:

  • CO Band: Fundamental, first overtone, etc.

  • Transition: J=1-0, J=2-1, etc.

  • Wavelength: Auto-populated or manual

  • Line width: Specify region size

  • Options: Single vs. multi-component

Buttons:

  • Measure: Extract flux

  • Analyze All: Multiple transitions

  • Cancel: Abort

Quick Commands

Most common operations:

  1. Load data: Ctrl+O

  2. Select region: R

  3. Export spectrum: Ctrl+E

  4. Fit single: F

  5. Fit cube: C

  6. Zoom: Ctrl+± or scroll

  7. View results: Shift+F

  8. Exit: Ctrl+Q

Command Line Options

To start IFU Analyzer with options:

python main.py [options]

Available options:

--file FILENAME

Open specified FITS file at startup

--region FILENAME

Load specified region at startup

--readonly

Open in read-only mode

--no-gui

Batch processing mode (advanced)

--help

Show command-line help

Example:

python main.py --file mycube.fits --region myregion.reg
